item.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour — Sat Oct 31, 9:00 AM — Unique Lancaster
item.description:
Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally!
Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century.
Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI.
But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region.

item.title: "Coffee with a Colonial" with Sam Leamer at Historic Rock Ford — Sun Nov 1 — Historic Rock Ford
item.description: “Coffee with a Colonial” brings the sights, sounds, and flavors of 18th century America to life. Experience the warmth and bustle of a colonial coffeehouse or tavern, where history isn’t just told – it’s lived! “Coffee with a Colonial” gives the opportunity to have a moment to sit down and enjoy sipping through history, enjoying a favorite beverage with discussion and interacting with 18th century material culture. Where the world is so busy today, living historian Samuel Leamer invites you to take a pause and enjoy the simple pleasure of conversation over and about coffee, either of the 18th or the 21st century variety. This program will be held in the kitchen of the General Hand Mansion. Please note that admission is for the presentation only and does not include the Snyder Gallery or Mansion Tour. YOU’RE INVITED to the Make-Believe Masquerade Ball! A celebration fit for superheroes, magical creatures, kings and queens! Step into a world of imagination and join us for a very special Halloween! Come dressed in your favorite costume and get ready for an enchanting day filled with music, dancing, creativity, and plenty of opportunities to make magical memories.
Dance the day away at the DJ Dance Party Show off your costume in the Costume Parade Strike a pose at our magical photo ops Get creative and inquisitive with themed STEM and Art activities
Whether you’re a fairy or a dinosaur, princess or superhero, all costumes are welcome at the ball! (Please keep costumes family-friendly) Choose your Celebration Time: Morning Ball: 10:00am – 12:00pm Afternoon Ball: 12:30pm – 2:30pm
Source: Discover Lancaster
